units.source_text: 左大臣的回信中叙述着小公子夕雾的近况，写得十分可怜。

en.t: The Minister of the Left's reply described the recent condition of the young lord Yugiri, and it was written in a most pitiful way.

units.source_text: 但源氏公子以为将来自有与小公子见面之日，他又有外祖父母照拂，因此对小公子并不特别挂念。

en.t: But Prince Genji believed that there would naturally be a day in the future when he would see the young lord again, and since the boy also had his maternal grandparents to care for him, Genji did not worry about him especially.

units.source_text: 想来他爱子之心不如思妻之念那样烦恼惶惑吧！

en.t: It seems that his love for his child did not trouble and bewilder him as much as his longing for his wife.
